title: docs(releases): after the 18.0.0 GA the index dates 18.0.0 "released 2026-10-19" (npm says 2026-10-20), and the v17 page still says "A plain install now resolves 17.7.0"
body:
Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023) · `os-warren` · session `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, from the #25102 dev's out-of-scope findings (PR #25146). Both are release-currency prose after the 18.0.0 GA cut, so one card covers them. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is stale (read at `origin/main` at 2026-10-22T00:28Z)

| Page | Text | What is true |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/releases/index.mdx:21` (`/docs/releases`) | v18 entry: "(current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-19)" | npm `time["18.0.0"]` = `2026-10-20T12:51:40Z`; the Version Packages commit `06cab4849a` is dated 2026-10-20; `releases/v18/18-0.mdx`'s description says "published 2026-10-20" |
| `content/docs/releases/v17/index.mdx:25` (`/docs/releases/v17`), the status blockquote | "A plain install now resolves 17.7.0." | npm `dist-tags.latest` = `18.0.0`: a plain install resolves 18.0.0 |

## Why it slipped (the dev's reading, to confirm)

- PR `8fbbd5082f` wrote the v18 status before the cut.
- `sync-release-index-currency.mjs` leaves alone a current-series field that already names the newest GA, whatever its date, so the version step never stamped the date.
- `check:release-page-status` passes the v17 page because it judges whether a release has shipped, not whether the page is current.
- The same class recurred before: #15332 ("the #10232 / #11649 defect class recurring a third time").

## Done when

- Both sentences say what npm says, each with its source.
- The fix decides whether the currency script should verify the date it leaves in place, so that this class does not recur at 18.1.0. If it should, that guard lands in the same PR. If it should not, the PR says why.
- ⛔ `content/docs/releases/**` is edited in a docs-only PR, never in a code PR.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` on objectstack, "release index current series 18.0.0 released date v17 plain install resolves 17.7.0 release page currency": 13 hits, none open. The nearest are #15332 (the same class at 17.3.0), #24569 (the v18 GA prose) and #24904 (the 18.0.0 release text).
